# Miscellaneous Abilities

## Ability Reference
- **Rage:** In battle, you fight with primal ferocity. On your turn, you can enter a rage as a bonus action, gaining advantage on Strength and resistance to physical damage.
- **Unarmored Defense:** While not wearing armor, AC = 10 + DEX Mod + CON Mod.
- **Sneak Attack:** ⚡ Passive — You know how to strike subtly. You deal extra damage when you have advantage.
